items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: A counter or dot pinned to an icon or avatar, separated from it by a transparent gap punched with a clip-path.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A step-by-step onboarding flow with a segmented progress indicator and previous/next buttons.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint
items.description: A contextual help bubble that opens from a small trigger, built on the Base UI Popover.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: Library-agnostic infinite pagination: a sentinel, polymorphic through Base UI useRender, fetches the next page when it scrolls into view, below the list or above it in reverse mode.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A strip of items sliding in a seamless loop, in CSS alone, only when they overflow, with edge fades, reverse and vertical tracks and pause on hover.

items.name: item-inset-separator
items.title: Item Inset Separator
items.description: A separator that rules an Item's bottom from where its content starts, so it follows each row's media.
